# Bilal Shafqat

> One-person digital marketing, design, and development studio based in Dubai, UAE, with 15+ years of experience. Bilal personally handles paid marketing, web and mobile development, design and content, and CRM/marketing automation for clients across the UAE and worldwide, without agency handoffs between departments.

## Who this is for

Startups and founders, real estate developers and agencies (UAE), in-house teams and growing companies, and agencies or consulting partners who need reliable delivery on marketing, design, or development work.

## Services

- Paid Marketing & Lead Generation: Google Search & Performance Max, Meta/LinkedIn/TikTok ad campaigns, lead and demand generation.
- Website & App Development: high-converting landing pages (Next.js), custom web and mobile apps, marketing tools and calculators.
- Design, Content & Conversion: social media strategy and asset design, B2B and real estate video editing, conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- CRM & Marketing Automation: HubSpot, Zoho, and Salesforce CRM setup, server-side tracking and Conversions API, marketing automation workflows.

## Key pages

- Pricing and how projects are costed: https://bilalshafqat.com/pricing

## Case studies

- LEOS Developments (https://bilalshafqat.com/portfolio/leos-developments): two-year engagement with a UK-headquartered residential developer that has offices in London and an experience centre in Dubai. Scope: corporate website build, brand social creative, and off-plan launch campaigns. Notable in that one person delivered both the website campaigns pointed at and the creative that drove traffic to it.
- Hadley Heights, for LEOS Developments (https://bilalshafqat.com/portfolio/leos-developments/hadley-heights): off-plan launch campaign for a 216-apartment development in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, with 1 and 2 bedroom apartments from AED 1 million. Deliverables: a lead capture landing page with a callback form and a brochure-download second entry point, plus a five-slide campaign carousel for paid and organic social.

## Engagement models

- Project-Based: a defined deliverable with a clear scope, timeline, and price.
- Monthly Retainer: ongoing marketing, design, or development support on a recurring basis.
- Ongoing Partner / Dedicated Support: embedded support alongside a client's team for larger initiatives.
- Consulting & Advisory: high-level review and guidance focused on clarity and measurable outcomes.
